name: CacheObjectInIndexTable
signature: extern "C" uint8_t mem_009977ED;   // element count (u8) extern "C" uint8_t mem_00B61219;   // flag: continue with table init even if calloc failed extern "C" uintptr_t mem_00B6114C; // pointer to dword table allocated by calloc extern "C" uint8_t mem_00B61150;   // next slot counter void fn_0079E9D0(void* obj)
summary: Lazily initialises the dword index table, claims the first free slot for obj (zero entry), stores that slot number at obj+0x0C, and advances mem_00B61150 when the slot equals it.
